reviewItem.question: Does "feat: \u200badd refreshPolicy field to ExternalSecret for enhanced synchronization control\u200b by @Sn0rt in https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pull/4…" mean a change to crd-field:external-secrets|group=external-secrets.io|kind=ExternalSecret|path=spec.refreshPolicy (added)?

proposed.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 adds a refreshPolicy field (CreatedOnce, Periodic or OnChange) to the ExternalSecret spec, and to ClusterExternalSecret's spec.externalSecretSpec, to control how the Secret is synchronized.
